snippet.title: Zendaya Playing “Who Would You Rather Choose?” Gets HILARIOUS
snippet.description:
Zendaya plays a game of “Who Would You Rather Choose?” and has to pick between different options without getting herself into trouble. Her reactions, hesitation, and facial expressions honestly make the whole thing even better. 

Zendaya has always been ridiculously entertaining in interviews because she doesn't need to force a funny moment. Whether she's answering uncomfortable questions, reacting to her co-stars, roasting Tom Holland, or immediately realizing she's said something she probably shouldn't have, her personality does all the work. 

Fans have also watched Zendaya grow from Rocky Blue on Disney Channel's Shake It Up into one of Hollywood's biggest stars. She went on to play MJ opposite Tom Holland's Peter Parker in the MCU's Spider-Man movies, delivered an Emmy-winning performance as Rue Bennett in Euphoria, and became Chani alongside Timothée Chalamet in the Dune franchise.




#zendaya #zendayaedit
